Name: Simple Hoarder Chest
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]📦 Simple Hoarder Chest 📦[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]This mod is made for PC. Android compatibility has not been tested.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]An upgradeable chest with specialised storage, search, custom tabs and built-in crafting. [b]Version 1.29[/b] adds safe tab management and Chests Anywhere remote access.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]⚠ H kits upgrade ONLY Hoarder Chests (SHC). They do not upgrade ordinary chests.[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]To upgrade:[/b] select the H kit in your hotbar, right-click a [b]placed Hoarder Chest[/b], then confirm. One kit adds [b]120 regular slots[/b].[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]✨ Storage & Controls[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]• [b]Main Chest[/b] gives an overview of all stored items. Category tabs organise materials, farming, fishing, foraging, minerals, food, equipment and miscellaneous items.
• Add up to [b]24 custom tabs[/b]; edit their names, icons and colours, and reorder them. [b]Hide or restore tabs[/b] without losing items or deposit routing. Delete [b]empty custom tabs[/b] with confirmation; Main stays visible and built-in tabs can be hidden.
• Search, deposit matching items and craft from your backpack or stored ingredients. Protected and favourite ingredients are respected.
• Scrollable storage and backpack grids, keyboard/controller controls, [b]25 UI themes[/b], chest colours and menus/settings in [b]12 languages[/b].[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]🛠 Get the Chest & Craft Kits[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Read Robin’s introduction letter, then buy the [b]25,000g recipe[/b] at her normal shop. It also teaches the H upgrade kit. Existing learned recipes and owned chests are preserved.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Both recipes use the same ingredients:[/b]
[b]1 empty regular Chest · 200 Wood · 15 Hardwood · 10 Iron Bars · 5 Gold Bars[/b]
Each craft produces one Hoarder Chest or one H kit. Occupied, special, favourite and protected chests cannot be used as the Chest ingredient.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]📈 Capacity & Settings[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]A new chest starts with [b]120 regular slots[/b]. Each H kit adds 120; the default upgrade ceiling is [b]1,200[/b], or [b]9,960[/b] with expanded capacity enabled. Raising the ceiling still requires crafting and applying kits.
Category/custom compartments default to [b]9,999 matching items[/b], with [b]999[/b] and [b]Unlimited[/b] options. Different qualities and item properties remain separate. Use the chest’s cog for settings; [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌐 Optional Integrations[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Chests Anywhere:[/b] remotely open the full SHC menu. Within SHC, use [b]Cog → Remote Hoard Chests[/b] to choose another eligible SHC chest. Chests Anywhere’s range, disabled-location and ignored-chest rules apply; its native dropdown overlay is replaced by SHC’s chooser while an SHC menu is open.
Also includes integrations for [b]Better Crafting[/b], [b]Convenient Inventory[/b], [b]MH Tool Pouch Extended[/b] and [b]Market Town[/b]. These mods are optional.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]📥 Installation & Notes[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b] and [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.1+[/url]. Extract the SimpleHoardChest folder into Mods, replacing the previous version. Use the same version for all multiplayer players.
Empty every compartment through Main before removing the mod. This update was checked with native desktop fixtures and Chests Anywhere 1.30.1; a live multiplayer/full-modpack session still needs confirmation.[/color][/size][/center]
